inventory.uom.description: Pack sizes you buy in, such as a case of 24 or a 25 kg sack. Deliveries can be entered in them and are converted to the item's unit.
inventory.uom.empty: No units yet. Add one, such as Case = 24 pc.
inventory.uom.archiveDescription: It can no longer be chosen on deliveries. Booked documents keep their quantities.
inventory.uom.factorInvalid: Enter how many base units it holds, with up to 6 decimals.
inventory.uom.baseUnitFixed: The base unit can't change: deliveries were converted with it.
inventory.attributes.description: What variants differ in, such as Size or Pack, with their values in the order you want them shown.
inventory.attributes.archiveDescription: It can no longer be used to generate variants. Existing variants keep their values.
inventory.attributes.valuesHint: Separate values with commas, in the order you want them shown.
inventory.attributes.valuesHintEdit: Separate values with commas. Existing variants keep the values they were made with.
inventory.attributes.valuesProblem.tooLo: Each value can have at most 40 characters.
inventory.attributes.valuesProblem.dupli: Each value can appear only once.
inventory.variants.description: Items sold or stocked in several versions. Each variant is its own stock item with its own stock and article number; the item itself then holds no stock.
inventory.variants.empty: No items with variants yet. Generate variants for an item to start.
inventory.variants.noAttributes: Add variant attributes first, such as Size.
inventory.boms.description: What a batch of a prepared item takes, such as 1 l tomato sauce from 2 kg tomatoes and 0.1 l oil. Production orders book them.
inventory.boms.deleteTitle: Delete the bill of materials for {name}?
inventory.boms.deleteDescription: It can no longer be produced until it gets a new one. Booked production orders stay as they are.
inventory.boms.duplicate: Each ingredient can appear only once.
inventory.production.description: Make a prepared item from its bill of materials: the ingredients leave the warehouse at their average cost and the item comes in at their value.
inventory.production.noBoms: No bills of materials yet. Add one under Bills of Materials.
inventory.production.enterQuantity: Enter a quantity to see what it takes.
inventory.production.noOrders: No production orders in this warehouse yet.
inventory.page.salePriceInvalid: Enter a price with up to 2 decimals.
inventory.errors.importInvalid: Some rows can't be imported. Check the preview, fix the file and try again.

inventory.invoice.title: Import vendor invoice
inventory.invoice.intro: Choose the supplier's invoice or order confirmation: the PDF, or photos of it. Check the lines it reads, then send it for approval; it is booked as a goods receipt once approved.
inventory.invoice.importDataHint: A supplier's invoice as a PDF or photos is read line by line, waits for approval, and is then booked as a goods receipt.
inventory.invoice.fileHint: A PDF, or one or more photos (JPG, PNG). Read on this device; only what you send is saved.
inventory.invoice.notPdf: Choose one PDF, or one or more photos (JPG, PNG, WebP).
inventory.invoice.noLines: No item lines found in this PDF. It may use a layout Durby doesn't read yet; you can enter the receipt under Inventory → More → Receive.
inventory.invoice.problems.unreadable: This file can't be read as a PDF.
inventory.invoice.problems.noText: No text could be read from this file. Try a sharper photo in good light, or ask the supplier for their PDF.
inventory.invoice.problems.tooManyPages: This PDF has more than 20 pages. Split it and import the parts.
inventory.invoice.rowProblems.duplicate: This item is on another line too. Combine them or pick another item.
inventory.invoice.rowProblems.newNotAllo: You can't create items: pick an existing one or leave the line out.
inventory.invoice.rowProblems.quantity: Enter a quantity above 0 with up to 3 decimals.
inventory.invoice.rowProblems.unitCost: Enter a cost with up to 4 decimals.
inventory.invoice.totalDiffers: The invoice says {amount}; its lines add up to {lines}. Check the lines left out or changed.
inventory.errors.vendorInvoiceNotFound: This vendor invoice doesn't exist or isn't yours to see.
inventory.errors.vendorInvoiceDecided: This invoice was approved, rejected or changed meanwhile. Reload it.
inventory.invoice.scannedHint: Read from a photo or scan: check every line against the paper.
inventory.invoice.sent: Sent for approval as {number} with {count} lines.
inventory.invoice.sentHint: Nothing is in stock yet: it is booked once someone approves it in the approval queue.
inventory.invoice.totalMatchesRounding: Matches the invoice total of {amount}, apart from {difference} from rounding piece prices.
inventory.invoice.totalDiffersSimple: The invoice says {amount}. Check lines left out or changed.
inventory.invoices.title: Approval queue
inventory.invoices.intro: Vendor invoices read and sent for approval. Approving books them as a goods receipt.
inventory.invoices.approvedAs: Approved by {name} and booked as goods receipt {number}.
inventory.invoices.approveDescription: {count} lines are booked into stock as one goods receipt.
inventory.invoices.approveWithNew: {count} lines are booked into stock as one goods receipt; {fresh} new items are created first.
inventory.invoices.newItemsHint: New items are created when the invoice is approved.
inventory.errors.mainWarehouseNotAllowed: Only someone who edits warehouses at every location can choose the main warehouse.
inventory.page.mainWarehouseHint: Supplies every branch: branches always request goods from it, and its staff pick and pack for all of them. Only one warehouse can be the main one.
inventory.page.warehouseLocationHint: Where the warehouse is, not which branches it supplies: the main warehouse supplies every branch wherever it is. Give a central warehouse its own location (add it under Branches first), not a shop's.
inventory.invoice.packHint: Count, weight, or both, e.g. 12 × 500 g
inventory.invoice.packInvalid: A whole count, and a weight above 0 with its unit
inventory.invoice.unitFactorInvalid: A number above 0, up to 6 decimals.
inventory.invoice.showRead: Show what was read from the pages
inventory.invoice.detailsTitle: Invoice details: check what was read
inventory.invoice.supplierMissing: Not read from the invoice: check the paper and fill it in.
inventory.invoice.countAsHint: As invoiced: the packs at the pack price. By the piece: every piece at the piece price.
inventory.page.supplyAllHint: Branches not ticked on another warehouse order from here. Only one warehouse can be the main one.
inventory.page.supplySomeHint: Their requests come from this warehouse.
inventory.page.supplyNoneHint: A branch's own store, or a store room.
inventory.errors.suppliesInvalid: A warehouse supplies other branches, not its own location.
